Junk food cravings can be a major hindrance when we are looking to lose weight or for that matter to achieve any fitness goal. But are there any substantial ways to deal with it?? Sure there are!
In this video, I share my Top 6 tips and 1 trick (it's magical) to reduce these cravings.
6 Ways to reduce these cravings are:
1. Drink water first.
2. Eat more protein 
3.Avoid getting too hungry
4. Get Enough sleep
5. Overcome Stress Eating
6.Psychological factor
1 TRICK
Tapping the forehead for 30 seconds definitely distracts from cravings.
This 1 trick that I have learnt is so effective that it works on a real junk foodie. I have shared my personal experience with you in this video.

I hope this video was helpful to you. If it was do:

LIKE | SHARE | COMMENT |

And do remember to SUBSCRIBE to my channel for more such videos!

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYC6Vcczj8v-Y5OgpEJTFBw

Thanks for visiting my channel !!!

segments.text: [00:00:00] Hello Friends! Welcome to Fit Tuber. Cravings. Unhealthy food cravings. Basically, what are cravings? The extreme desire to eat something specific doesn’t matter if we are hungry or not, it could be anything. For e.g. a chocolate, Pastries, Samosa, Pizza, Burger or anything else is called a craving. [00:00:19] Cravings are natural and we all have experienced cravings some time or the other. If we are trying for weight loss or some other fitness goal then cravings can be our biggest enemy. Can we reduce our cravings? Yes, we can. Today, I will share with you 6 ways by which you can easily reduce your cravings. [00:00:37] Not just that. I will tell you a magical trick using which you can destroy your cravings in just 30 seconds. So stay tuned and watch this video till the very end. Often, our mind gets confused whether we are actually hungry or just dehydrated. [00:00:55] Next time, whenever you experience a craving, drink a glass of water. Naturally, after drinking water our hunger reduces. So wait for some time (30 min) and then judge if you are still craving. There are high chances that your cravings will disappear. [00:01:14] On an average, the protein intake of we Indians is very less. It is essential to consume a specific amount of protein every day. Proteins can reduce your cravings because they are difficult to breakdown. It takes time. Your body stays busy and as a result you don’t get cravings. [00:01:36] This is a very effective way to reduce your cravings. When we are extremely hungry, we may get uncontrollable and can make wrong choices. The cravings tend to increase then. We feel like eating chocolate, pizza, burgers, chhole bhature etc. [00:02:01] And you don’t get uncontrollable about your food desires. It has been proven that the people who sleep less and feel tired, they crave more. As their body is tired, they need something to eat all the time to stay energized. [00:02:18] So, it is important to sleep for 7-8 hours daily. It is essential for our body, our mind. And also it helps reduce cravings. When we are stressed out, we tend to eat. You can go out for a walk, you can exercise, you can call a friend etc. If we want to achieve some fitness goal, we need to be mentally strong. [00:02:53] We should visualize ourselves that if I keep eating junk food then how will I look in 6 months or 1 year. You should always a healthy option as a backup. And trust me; cravings last not more than 10 minutes. [00:03:56] If you wait for those 10 minutes, if you stay strong, they will go away. Ok now comes the fun part. I promised that I will tell you one technique by which your cravings will get destroyed in 30 seconds. There was a social experiment conducted on obese people by Obese Society in Boston. If you tap your forehead your 30 seconds, your cravings will go away. [00:04:15] It may sound weird but it is very effective. I did not believe it until I tested it on my brother. My younger brother is a junk food lover. He will not stop eating junk, no matter what. 5 Weight Loss Mistakes that most people do. 
Are you finding it difficult to lose weight? Are you not able to lose fat from your body? If yes, then this video is for you. In this video, I will share with you the most common weight loss and fat loss mistakes.

00:25 - Weight Loss Mistake # 1 - Stop measuring your progress in Kgs and start measuring it in inches. 
Yes. Suppose you start working out and after a few days you step on weighing scale and you see that you have not reduced even a single kg. Well, let that number not decide how well you are doing. Watch out the video to know what you should be doing.

01:11 - Weight Loss Mistake #2 - Doing wrong workout.
Most people think that doing cardiovascular exercise on a treadmill, running for long period of time will help them reduce a lot of weight. This is not true. Cardio training is great for heart health but it is not ideal for weight loss. 

02:02 - Weight Loss Mistake # 3 - Underestimating the calories.
 In order to lose weight, a person should consume calories less than the maintenance calories. Everybody knows that. But what many people don’t know is that how many calories a particular food contains. And in this process they end up underestimating the calories that they have consumed. A study shows that people tend of underestimate the calories by as much as 50%. This is one of the major reasons why people fail to lose weight. 

02:53 - Weight Loss Mistake # 4 - Overloading yourself.
Doing weight loss is not a one or two day process. It is a journey in itself. It demands you to change your various eating habits. Now, if you suddenly subject yourself to a hardcore diet and start working out along with it, there are high chances that you get frustrated in between and stop the journey altogether. So, it is always better to take small steps. 

03:53 - Weight Loss Mistake # 5 - Making it Uncomfortable  Unfortunately, for many people the idea of a weight loss diet is starvation. People who skip their breakfast, lunch actually eat like a dinosaur in their dinner. Never make this mistake. This is simply because starvation is not sustainable. Nor is it healthy. Similarly, some people after working out will take the liberty and pamper themselves with delicious food outside. This happens because they have put themselves into uncomfortable position which are not sustainable for long. Never do this mistake.

Quick and Easy Recipe for breakfast as we generally do not have much time in the morning to prepare our breakfast.
This is customized Oatmeal along with Boiled Eggs. It is an easy , healthy and tasty meal.
All the ingredients used are highly nutritional and are ideal to be consumed in breakfast.
Ingredients used:

Natural Quaker Oats (40 g)
Low Fat Milk (1 glass (approx 250 ml)
Almonds (10-12 nos.)
Walnuts (1 no.)
Flax seeds (1 teaspoon)
Raisins (6-7 nos.)
Banana (1 medium sized)
Hard Boiled eggs (2 nos.)
Cinnamon (a pinch)

You can customize this meal in your own way. 
you can replace oats with whole wheat or any other whole grain porridge .
You can add other nuts like 
Cashews, Peanuts etc.

You can your choice of fruit like
An Apple
Berries
A Mango
Grapes
Plums
A Papaya etc.

If you are lactose intolerant, you can replace Diary milk with Almond milk or Soy Milk etc.
